# agenco_mcp_source (Resource)

Manages an MCP configuration source — one upstream an application pulls tools from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A REST source whose tools come from an imported OpenAPI document.
resource "agenco_mcp_source" "orders_api" {
  application_id = agenco_application.storefront.id
  name           = "Orders API"
  type           = "REST"
  source_url     = "https://api.example.com"

  # The dashboard sets content-type on REST sources by default.
  override_headers {
    key   = "content-type"
    value = "application/json"
  }

  override_headers {
    key   = "X-Api-Key"
    value = var.orders_api_key
  }
}

# An OAuth-protected upstream MCP server, proxied per user.
resource "agenco_mcp_source" "partner_mcp" {
  application_id             = agenco_application.storefront.id
  name                       = "Partner MCP"
  type                       = "MCP_PROXY"
  source_url                 = "https://mcp.partner.example.com/mcp"
  external_authorization_url = "https://auth.partner.example.com"
  scopes                     = ["read:tools", "write:tools"]
  two_step_callback          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application this source belongs to.
- `name` (String) Source name, up to 36 characters.
- `source_url` (String) Upstream URL. Must be HTTPS with a valid TLD unless is_local is true.
- `type` (String) Source type. One of: [REST GRAPHQL MOCK MCP_PROXY FRONTEGG CUSTOM_INTEGRATION CUSTOM_CODE]. Immutable after create.

### Optional

- `api_timeout` (Number) Upstream request timeout in milliseconds, at least 500 and at most 5000 unless the account allows extended timeouts. The API requires this field, so the provider defaults it to 5000 for consistency with agenco_mcp_configuration.
- `client_id` (String) Pre-registered OAuth client ID. When set, the gateway skips Dynamic Client Registration.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Pre-registered OAuth client secret. Omit for public clients.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the source is enabled.
- `external_authorization_url` (String) HTTPS authorization server URL. Setting it marks the source as OAuth-protected and makes the gateway run per-user OAuth at runtime.
- `is_local` (Boolean) Whether the source is local, relaxing the HTTPS and DNS checks on source_url. Immutable after create.
- `override_headers` (Block List) Headers injected into every outbound request from this source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--override_headers))
- `scopes` (List of String) OAuth scopes requested when authenticating with this source.
- `slug` (String) Instance discriminator for running more than one instance of the same source. Lowercase kebab-case, up to 64 characters. Changing it re-labels the source's imported tools.
- `two_step_callback` (Boolean) Whether the gateway OAuth callback requires an explicit user confirmation before exchanging the authorization code.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Source ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Source secret issued by Frontegg.
- `vendor_id` (String) Vendor that owns the source.

<a id="nestedblock--override_headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `override_headers`

Required:

- `key` (String) Header name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Header value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Sources are read per application, so import takes "application_id/source_id".
terraform import agenco_mcp_source.orders_api 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789/11112222-3333-4444-5555-666677778888
```
